links.comparator_used: Clinician-only drafting from scratch using matched templates (an unedited LLM-only group was also reported)
links.outcome: Documentation creation time and expert-rated document quality for discharge summaries and referrals
links.effect: Creation time for summaries: β = -59.4 seconds (95% CI, -150.6 to 31.7; P = .18). Creation time for referrals: β = 52.9 seconds (95% CI, -7.0 to 112.9; P = .08). Neither difference was statistically significant. Quality was higher with clinician-in-the-loop in most expert-rated domains. LLM-only drafts were fastest but had the lowest quality.
links.tradeoff: Referral creation took longer with clinician-in-the-loop (+52.9 s, not significant). No significant time saving overall. Small pilot with simulated records (17 physicians completed).
links.quote: In most expert-rated quality domains, the clinician-in-the-loop workflow outperformed clinician-only drafting.

design_hint: clinician-in-the-loop review and editing of LLM drafts
